fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: Raw Internet Archive id_ replay of a fixed capture, fetched with plain curl (no Accept-Encoding, no decoding). First downloaded on 2026-09-28T17:33:25Z; downloaded again at 2026-09-28T18:25:24Z, 2026-09-28T19:04:48Z, the last at least 30 minutes after the first, each with the same byte count and SHA-256 (8784 bytes). The base32 SHA-1 of the bytes equals the Internet Archive's CDX digest for the capture.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the Freedom Front's or Freedom Front Plus's original page, captured at 2006-10-07T03:49:31Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of any live copy (the old www.vryheidsfront.co.za pages are no longer served, and the current www.vfplus.org.za pages carry rotating embedded blocks). rows.text: In his speech dated 21/06/2001 in the budget debate on President Mbeki's office, Dr Pieter Mulder says "I am also a newly elected party leader. Of course I also want to make a success of my leadership".
In the same speech he says "When I was elected as leader of the Freedom Front in March I committed myself to try to get win win solutions".

locator.section: Second paragraph, beginning "When I was elected as leader of the Freedom Front in March"
